messages:
mia (Docs): Hey team, I'm opening a small PR to tighten the SOC 2 / audit log wording and add a Node SDK snippet + retention API example. Need a quick legal + security sanity check before I merge. TL;DR: recommend retention defaults, point to redaction guide, show SDK header and retention API payload.

sam (Security): Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) Don't assert hard guarantees in public docs. Use language like 'recommended' or 'typical' unless it's contractually guaranteed. 2) Call out that logs are stored append-only with integrity monitoring and that deletions are audited/authorized. Also mention redaction of PII is available/encouraged.

eli (Legal): Echo sam. Also add a line that retention may be extended for legal/regulatory obligations and per-customer agreements. Avoid specifying retention as an immutable promise. If we keep numbers, prefix with 'recommended' and coordinate with sales for any contractual commitments.

mia (Docs): Draft paragraph I'm planning to add:

"Audit logs: Redwood retains audit logs to support security investigations, compliance, and contractual obligations. Recommended retention windows are 90 days for development environments and 24 months for production audit records. Actual retention is configurable and may be extended to meet legal or contractual requirements. For private deployments, customers can control retention settings through the console or the retention API. Sensitive fields can be redacted before long-term storage; see the redaction guide for details."

jonah (DevEx): tiny wording nit: switch "we retain" -> "Redwood retains" for consistency across docs. Also we need an SDK example showing an audit header for traceability — I can provide a short Node snippet.

mia (Docs): Updated. Adding Jonah's SDK snippet (Node):

```js
// attach audit metadata for traceability and audit correlation
const response = await client.generate({
  model: 'rw-instruct-1',
  input: 'Summarize this report',
  headers: { 'x-redwood-audit-id': 'cust-7890-evt-2026' }
});
```

alex (Infra): For Dedicated/Private docs please include a retention API example so infra/customers know the payload shape. Example: 

```json
{
  "policy_name": "prod-default",
  "retention_days": 730,
  "redaction": {
    "pii_fields": ["email", "ssn"],
    "method": "mask"
  }
}
```

sam (Security): Add a sentence: "Audit logs are stored in append-only storage with integrity checks; any deletions are logged and require approval." That helps auditors during assessments.

eli (Legal): Also mention that retention periods may be influenced by customer contracts and laws. If a customer-specific SLA exists, it supersedes the recommended defaults.

mia (Docs): I'll change the copy to: 

"Recommended retention: 90 days (dev), 24 months (prod). Actual retention is configurable and subject to customer agreements and legal obligations."

jonah (DevEx): One last check: the redaction guide link used in the draft points to /docs/redaction#audit-logs. Does that anchor exist? If not, I'll update after Alex confirms.

alex (Infra): Confirmed that the anchor currently lives at /docs/data-redaction#audit-logs in the docs site. Mia, please update the link in the PR to that anchor.

mia (Docs): Thanks — I'll update the link and incorporate wording changes from both of you. Planning to mark this PR ready for merge after legal sign-off. Deploy-bot: CI run queued.

deploy-bot: PR build: ✅, staging: ✅, merging to main after final review.

mia (Docs): Great, thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the PR with a short changelog entry and link to the retention API reference. :pray:
